mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level directly reduces the risk-free rate, increasing the present value of equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly CPI inflation rate above 2.5% signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in less than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a weakening economy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in less than 50% of periods when RSAFS declines and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in manufacturing production (INDPRO) below 100 (index) indicates a supply-side shock that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in less than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for UNRATE as a predictor of 5-day S&P 500 returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or correlation with returns is positive in >50% of windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts (HOUST) above 1.3 million units signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1.3 million units.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a monetary tightening during an economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in less than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and PAYEMS falls.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 3.0% indicates robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in less than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 3.0%.
